title: Transcribe
emptyBody: Transcribed audio and video appear here.
selectHint: Pick a transcription from the list.
landingTitle: Turn media into an editable document
landingBody: Import audio or video to get a timestamped transcript.
formatsHint: Works with mp3, wav, m4a, mp4, mov and other common formats.

linkOnly.playbackHint: This transcription keeps no media — only the transcript and its source link. Fetch the media back to enable playback, line jumping and speaker separation.

fetch.title: Import from link
fetch.subtitle: Paste a video page URL — Lunarca downloads it and transcribes automatically
fetch.probingSlow: Still waiting for the site to respond…
fetch.truncated: This list has {{count}} more items that are not shown (up to {{limit}} at a time). Import the rest in batches.

media.link_onlyHint: Transcript and link only — least disk

fetch.linkOnlyNote: The media is deleted after transcription; only the transcript and link are kept. If the source is taken down, it can't be fetched again.
fetch.noFfmpeg: No ffmpeg found, so only the site's pre-merged quality is available (usually 720p or less). Install ffmpeg to get 1080p.
fetch.consent: Make sure you have the right to download and use this content, and respect the source site's terms of service.

state.missingBody: Install it once to import from links.
state.timeoutTitle: The downloader is slow to respond
state.timeoutBody: It is usually fine — check again.
state.brokenBody: Reinstall it, or open Diagnostics to see which file was found.
state.checkingBody: This usually takes a few seconds.

fetch.installPartial: yt-dlp {{version}} is installed, but Deno was not: {{reason}} Sites such as YouTube may fail to download.
fetch.strictLocalBody: Importing from a link downloads over the network. Turn off strict local mode to use it.
fetch.installHint: If yt-dlp is installed somewhere unusual, set its path. Then press Check again — no restart needed.

plan.title: Install plan

component.yt_dlp_replace: yt-dlp (video downloader, replaces the installed copy)

plan.note: Downloads are verified individually. Update or uninstall managed copies under Apps › Import from link.
plan.scope: Manages only copies installed by Lunarca. System installations are unchanged.

rights.title: Before you import from a link
rights.description: Only import content you own or are authorized to use, and follow the source platform’s terms of service. Lunarca does not read your browser sign-ins and does not bypass sign-in, paywalls or DRM. You confirm this once and won’t be asked again.

fetchError.toolMissing: yt-dlp was not found. Install it under Apps › Import from link, or set its path there.
fetchError.toolUnusable: yt-dlp cannot run (permission problem or corrupt file). Please reinstall it.
fetchError.toolOutdated: The download tool is out of date and can no longer read this site. Check for updates under Apps › Installed, click Update, then try again. If you installed it yourself with Homebrew, upgrade it there.
fetchError.unsupportedUrl: That is not a valid web address. Paste a video page link starting with http:// or https://.
fetchError.unsupportedSite: No video could be extracted from that page. Check that the link points to a video page rather than a home page or search result.
fetchError.loginRequired: This content requires a sign-in, membership or age verification. Lunarca does not store credentials on your behalf — please use a publicly accessible link.
fetchError.geoBlocked: This content is not available in your region. Set a download proxy under Settings › Recording & transcription, then retry.
fetchError.unavailable: This content has been removed or does not exist.
fetchError.liveStream: A live stream cannot be transcribed — it has no end. Import it once the stream has finished.
fetchError.network: The network connection failed. Check your connection, or set a download proxy under Settings › Recording & transcription.
fetchError.noCompatibleFormat: This link has no format Lunarca can process (it needs MP4 video or an M4A / AAC audio track). When downloading video, installing ffmpeg adds formats that can be merged; otherwise save the file to this Mac and add it with “Import file”.
fetchError.insufficientDisk: Not enough disk space to store this media.
fetchError.toolFailed: The download failed. Retry later, or upgrade yt-dlp.
fetchError.noOutput: The download finished but produced no usable file. Retry, or switch to audio only.
fetchError.badProbeOutput: Could not read video details from that page. Check the link, or upgrade yt-dlp.
fetchError.io: A local file operation failed. Check disk space and permissions.
fetchError.strictLocal: Strict local mode is on and blocked the network download. Turn it off in privacy settings and retry.
fetchError.unknown: The download failed for an unknown reason. Retry, or upgrade yt-dlp.
fetchError.toolInstallFailed: Installation failed. Retry, or install it yourself with brew install yt-dlp.
fetchError.toolChecksumMismatch: The downloaded file failed its checksum and was discarded (likely a transfer error). Please retry.
fetchError.toolNoChecksum: Upstream did not publish a checksum for this file, so the install was aborted for safety. Retry later, or install it yourself.
fetchError.toolUninstallFailed: Uninstall failed: the file could not be removed. Delete it in Finder, or retry later.
fetchError.toolPlanChanged: Something on this Mac just changed, so the plan was updated. Review it, then install.
fetchError.queueExpired: The server could not get to this transcription within its promised window, so it expired (you were not charged). The audio is still there — press Retry to queue it again.
fetchError.resultUnavailable: The result couldn't be retrieved; your note is unchanged. Transcribing again is a new run and is billed again.
fetchError.hostRejected: The site refused this download (HTTP 403). This almost always means the download tool is behind the site's latest changes: check for updates under Apps › Installed, then try again.
fetchError.jsRuntimeMissing: yt-dlp needs a JavaScript runtime to solve this site’s playback challenge, and none is installed. Install Deno with one click under Apps › Import from link (or install Node / Bun yourself), then retry.

deleteDesc: It moves to the Trash and can be restored at any time.
noMatchBody: Try another keyword, or clear the filter to see everything.

exportOptions.title: Export options
exportOptions.hint: Applies to every export from now on: single, batch, and the context menu all use these.
exportOptions.timeOffsetDesc: Positive delays, negative advances; anything shifted below 0 is clamped to 0.
exportOptions.lineLengthDesc: Auto = 42 for Latin, 20 for CJK (Netflix guideline). LRC never wraps; this only splits it into more lines.
exportOptions.speaker: Speaker prefix
exportOptions.speakerDesc: Write "Name: " on the first line when a segment has a speaker.
exportOptions.bomDesc: Some older players need it to detect CJK text; the change is remembered as the default.
exportOptions.hanDesc: Convert Chinese to Simplified or Traditional before exporting (Taiwan and Hong Kong use different characters). Uses a dictionary, not AI; other text is left alone.
